On October 21, SSE 50 closed at 2747.05 (-0.68%) and CSI 1000 closed at 6780.26 (+0.20%), resulting in a 50/1000 ratio of 0.4052.
INE crude oil (SC2612) closed at 716.5 RMB/bbl on October 21 with a settlement of 700.8 RMB/bbl, and completed night session trading around 714 RMB/bbl.
